SPECIFICATION FOR FIXED INSULATED HERMETICALLY SEALED TANTALUM CAPACITORS WITH SOLID ELECTROLYTE
PART 4 TYPE Section FCST 3 1 Polar

D. General -This standard shall be read in conjunction with IS : 8507 (Part II-1977 `Specification for fixed insulated, hermetically sealed tantalum capacitors with solid electrolyte : Part 1 General requirements and methods of tests'. 1. ScopeThis standard covers the detail requirements for capacitors, electrolytic, polar, moulded in construction with axial leadouts. 2. Outline Drawing and Dimensions Fig. 1 and Tables 1 and 2. fixed with solid tantalum
